text:
maya (PM): quick check 100000 2 new Invite + Roles panel in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/uxnew. Three asks: SSO toggle scope, compact row actions, and a fast path to audit events (Audit Finder). any blockers? :eyes:

ol (Designer): uploaded two variants: header-level SSO toggle and compact inline toggle. dense rows use a right-aligned micro-kebab. concern: discoverability if we hide actions.

ben (Frontend): hover-only actions cause layout shift in Safari. prefer always-visible micro-kebab with low opacity. will need to keep action column fixed width to avoid reflow. also ensure 44px hit targets for touch.

rita (Eng): accessibility: micro-kebab must be a real button with aria-label and focusable. role chips need aria-pressed/aria-selected states and readable labels like "Role: Billing Admin, assigned". also add aria-live for assignment confirmations.

lee (Support): tickets note: users can't find audit often. add a persistent Audit icon in header that opens Audit Finder + small link icon on timestamps to anchor the finder to that event. confirmation when enabling org-level SSO would cut support noise.

a11y-bot: checklist: SSO toggle has aria-checked + aria-describedby, micro-kebab keyboard reachable, roles grid is semantic (table or labelled list), Audit Finder traps focus and is labelled. ensure visible focus rings in compressed rows.

ol (Designer): copy tweak: change "Invite team" -> "Invite people". SSO label option: "Enforce SSO sign-in" with helper text "blocks non-SSO logins". i'll mock short label + helper.

ben (Frontend): we'll surface helper via aria-describedby so SRs get context without UI break. i'll spike timestamp->audit anchor route param with graceful fallback if audit not enabled.

rita (Eng): i'll run a keyboard + VO walkthrough once the updated frames are posted. will call out any blockers.

maya (PM): thanks! next steps: ol update figma with micro-kebab + audit icon + copy variants; ben spike anchor + touch behavior; rita a11y pass; lee draft KB for SSO copy + Audit Finder. reconvene Fri AM. :calendar:
